query:
SELECT file_hash,
        COUNT(*) AS "n!: i64",
        MIN(title) AS "title?: String",
        MIN(artist) AS "artist?: String",
        MIN(album) AS "album?: String"
        FROM tracks
        WHERE library_id = ? AND file_hash IS NOT NULL AND marked_for_deletion = 0
        GROUP BY file_hash
        HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        ORDER BY 2 DESC, 4, 5, 3
